subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight details are as follows: - Departure: New York JFK on May 15th, 2022 at 10:00 AM - Arrival: Paris CDG on May 15th, 2022 at 10:30 PM Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We wish you a pleasant journey! Best regards, The Travel Agency
